### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | quantms output directory of one mode (the folder holding diannsummary/, msstats/, mzmlstatistics/, sdrfparsing/ and pipeline_info/). For the megatest this is the mode_dia/ folder. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The SDRF the run was started with (--input). Optional: the design is already in sdrfparsing/, the SDRF adds its characteristics columns. Defaults to input/sdrf.tsv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Hub id column. The quantms hub is keyed on run_id, the raw file name without its extension; this only records that value. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Hub column the dashboard groups and filters runs by. Defaults to condition, the MSstats condition of the design. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/quantms/acquisition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/acquisition.py) | Spectra acquired per run: one row per mzML file. | `run_id`, `ms1_spectra`, `ms2_spectra`, `ms2_per_ms1`, `median_ms2_peaks`, `median_base_peak_intensity`, `rt_start_min`, `rt_end_min`, `gradient_min`, `ms2_per_min` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/acquisition_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/acquisition_profile.py) | Acquisition over the gradient: one row per run and minute of retention time. | `run_id`, `rt_min`, `ms1_spectra`, `ms2_spectra`, `median_base_peak_intensity` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/comparisons.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/comparisons.py) | MSstats group comparisons: one row per protein and contrast. | `protein`, `protein_group`, `genes`, `contrast`, `condition_a`, `condition_b`, `log2fc`, `abs_log2fc`, `se`, `t_value`, `df`, `p_value`, `adj_p_value`, `missing_pct`, `imputed_pct`, `issue`, `mean_a`, `mean_b`, `avg_log2_intensity`, `direction` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/ms2_peak_bins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/ms2_peak_bins.py) | How many peaks an MS2 spectrum holds, per run: one row per run and peak-count bin. | `run_id`, `peaks`, `bin_start`, `spectra`, `fraction` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/precursors.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/precursors.py) | Identified precursors of a DIA-NN run: one row per precursor and run. | `run_id`, `protein_group`, `protein_name`, `genes`, `peptide`, `peptidoform`, `charge`, `charge_state`, `length`, `missed_cleavages`, `n_variable_mods`, `modification_state`, `specificity`, `q_value`, `pg_q_value`, `cscore`, `evidence`, `spectrum_similarity`, `ms1_profile_corr`, `rt_min`, `predicted_rt_min`, `rt_error_min`, `peak_width_min`, `quantity_quality`, `log10_quantity` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/protein_conditions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/protein_conditions.py) | One row per protein group and condition: abundance and its spread over the condition's runs. | `protein_group`, `protein_name`, `genes`, `runs`, `mean_log2_intensity`, `sd_log2_intensity`, `cv_pct` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/protein_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/protein_summary.py) | One row per protein group: how many runs detected it, how strongly and with how many peptides. | `protein_group`, `protein_name`, `genes`, `description`, `peptides`, `peptide_support`, `runs_detected`, `runs_total`, `detected_pct`, `detection`, `mean_log2_intensity`, `cv_pct`, `abundance_rank` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/proteins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/proteins.py) | Protein-group quantities of a DIA-NN run: one row per protein group and run. | `run_id`, `protein_group`, `protein_name`, `genes`, `description`, `intensity`, `log2_intensity`, `peptides`, `precursors` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/replicate_pairs.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/replicate_pairs.py) | Protein-group intensities in two runs of the same condition, for every pair of runs. | `protein_group`, `protein_name`, `genes`, `pair`, `run_x`, `run_y`, `log2_x`, `log2_y` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/run_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/run_summary.py) | One row per run: what was identified and how clean the identifications are. | `run_id`, `precursors`, `peptides`, `protein_groups`, `ms2_spectra`, `precursors_per_1000_ms2`, `modified_pct`, `missed_cleavage_pct`, `median_abs_rt_error_min`, `median_peak_width_min`, `median_log10_quantity`, `run_label` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/sample_correlation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/sample_correlation.py) | Run-to-run Pearson correlation of the protein-group intensities. | `run_id` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/sample_embedding.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/sample_embedding.py) | Principal components of the runs, from the protein-group intensities. | `run_id`, `dim_1`, `dim_2`, `explained_1`, `explained_2`, `proteins_used` |
| [`nf-core/quantms/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/quantms/recipes/samples.py) | Run hub for nf-core/quantms: one row per MS raw file, from the experimental design. | `run_id`, `sample`, `condition`, `condition_raw`, `replicate`, `run_label`, `bio_replicate`, `fraction`, `acquisition`, `label`, `enzyme`, `precursor_tolerance`, `fragment_tolerance`, `dissociation`, `fixed_mods`, `variable_mods` |
